title: 2007 – Hong Kong Mobile Film Festival
author: hkwtia
plainText: WTIA organized the first Hong Kong Mobile Film Festival in 2007. With activities including production contest, seminar and workshops, the festival aims to nurture local youngsters’ interest and knowledge in mobile film productions and promote the awareness of mobile films appreciation among the general public.
